name: Acceptance test 10 - negated organization condition expands trust (role-trust, supported)
note: IAM-801: the role-trust family is now SUPPORTED via the family-aware trust evaluator. A StringNotEquals aws:PrincipalOrgID reads as an EXPANSION (dangerous polarity): it permits principals OUTSIDE the named organization, not a restriction to it. This is a critical TRUST-ORG-EXPANSION finding; the operator is classified as expansion/exclusion, NOT a protective org restriction, and the remediation never claims aws:PrincipalOrgID is 'missing'. The assumed role's permissions stay out of scope/unknown.
